592:t_1:86.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Striking at $$バナージ$$, who knows where the Box is, and us, who oppose the Empire, would kill two birds with one stone.」

592:t_1:87.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What's more, Ensign $$リディ$$, who leads $$クロノ$$'s strike force, is directing his personal feelings at $$バナージ$$.」

592:t_1:89.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「About $$ラプラスの箱$$... What are these 'depths' Colonel $$シャア$$ mentioned?」

592:t_1:90.en:
$$シャア$$
「...$$フル・フロンタル$$ has been working to obtain the Box since I was the leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

592:t_1:91.en:
$$シャア$$
「So $$フロンタル$$ seems to have investigated its contents to a certain extent.」

592:t_1:92.en:
$$シャア$$
「Still, that's only conjecture. That knowledge only becomes meaningful once he obtains the Box.」

592:t_1:93.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That's why he seeks the Box.」

592:t_1:94.en:
$$シャア$$
「But he also believes what he knows of its contents is only superficial.」

592:t_1:95.en:
$$シャア$$
「He seems to think its depths... its true meaning, hold the power to transform even this multiverse.」

592:t_1:96.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But the Box is a relic of a $$宇宙世紀$$ world... Just one world within $$ＵＣＷ$$, which is itself only one part of our current world.」

592:t_1:97.en:
$$オットー$$
「Even if today's $$地球連邦$$ descends from the $$宇宙世紀$$'s $$地球連邦$$, I can't imagine anything that could shake it.」

592:t_1:98.en:
$$桂$$
「Colonel, have you heard $$フル・フロンタル$$'s theory?」

592:t_1:100.en:
$$シャア$$
「If his theory is correct, the Box certainly has enough power to shake the $$宇宙世紀$$'s $$地球連邦$$.」

592:t_1:103.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Let's stop there, Colonel. There's no point hearing it here.」

592:t_1:104.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I agree. And we should respect $$バナージ$$ and Princess $$ミネバ$$'s wishes about revealing the Box entrusted to them.」

592:t_1:106.en:
$$シャア$$
(I'm sure they'll steer the Box's contents in the right direction.)

592:t_1:107.en:
$$シャア$$
(My role is to stop the one who would prevent that... $$フル・フロンタル$$...)

592:t_1:112.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...So this is the $$フルアーマー・ユニコーン$$...」

592:t_1:113.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「What do you think, $$バナージ$$? $$カミーユ$$ and the others checked my idea, and I assembled it with $$アストナージ$$ and his team.」

592:t_1:114.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You call it armor... But it doesn't have any more armor, does it...?」

592:t_1:115.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「The best defense is a good offense! All these weapons will be the power that protects $$ユニコーン$$!」

592:t_1:116.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It works like the $$リ・ガズィ$$'s $$バック・ウェポン・システム$$. You can jettison it in battle once you've used up the ammo.」

592:t_1:117.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thanks, $$タクヤ$$. I'll master it.」

592:t_1:118.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The black $$ユニコーン$$... $$バンシィ$$ will be here soon.」

592:t_1:120.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ will target you. If you don't want to fight him, stay back.」

592:t_1:121.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Honestly, I don't really understand what Ensign $$リディ$$ is fighting for.」

592:t_1:122.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But... I believe I have to stop him. With my own hands.」

592:t_1:124.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But don't put too much pressure on yourself.」

592:t_1:126.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I was his first target, after all.」

592:t_1:127.en:
$$シン$$
「Oh, right, you were. You were competing to be the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$'s ace, weren't you?」

592:t_1:128.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ is single-minded. A little too much so.」

592:t_1:130.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It's an unchangeable fact that he joined $$クロノ$$.」

592:t_1:131.en:
$$刹那$$
「But even if he can't redo that past, he can still change.」

592:t_1:134.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you want to stop him from fighting, we'll help you.」

592:t_1:138.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Ah... Nothing... I just thought it was strange...」

592:t_1:139.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$ガンダム$$ pilots from all these different worlds are encouraging $$バナージ$$ together...」

592:t_1:140.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Yes. $$ガンダム$$s that would normally never have met are gathered here.」

592:t_1:141.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe there's some meaning in that.」

592:t_1:143.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And soon, the white and black $$ガンダム$$s will fight.」

592:t_1:144.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「You mean Ensign $$リディ$$'s $$バンシィ$$...」

592:t_1:145.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ガンダム$$s gathered from many different worlds...)

592:t_1:146.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Do those who bear the $$烙印$$ pilot $$ガンダム$$s, or are $$ガンダム$$ pilots given the $$烙印$$...?)

592:t_1:147.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I feel we'll have the answer soon...)

592:t_2:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You're... entrusting the future... to us...?」

592:t_2:7.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You...! Did you come to tell me that at the very end!?」

592:t_2:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(You were my light... The light that gave me life a second time...)

592:t_2:12.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Princess... This is as far as $$マリーダ・クルス$$ can go.)

592:t_2:13.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$マリーダ$$... I'm sorry... I... never did anything to...」

592:t_2:14.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Princess, please hold firmly onto $$バナージ$$. Otherwise, he'll...)

592:t_3:3.en: ～$$ソレスタルビーイング号$$　$$ヴェーダ$$ Core～

592:t_3:5.en:
???
「In accordance with the pact, beginning preparations to disclose information level 8.」

592:t_3:6.en:
???
「Hehe... The day is finally coming, $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$...」

592:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. The owner, $$ＡＧ$$, is absent today, so $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will operate under our caretaker service.」

592:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please understand that our congratulations to ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion.」

592:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

593:t_000:0.en:
$$アレク$$
「The $$クロノ$$ force will soon enter visual range.」
